source_grounded_observation: Cycle 6 established executable L1 representation reachability, but NativeRepresentationGenesisEngine still enumerates a fixed named primitive family set. Its generator language cannot synthesize a representation outside DIFFERENCE/XOR/ORDER_CANONICAL regardless of candidate budget.
hypothesis: A pre-hidden BODY mutation of the GENERATOR organ can install an inherited compositional representation-genesis policy. After BODY checkpoint/restore, that policy can synthesize executable task-specific representation expressions from support examples that the cycle-6 fixed-family parent cannot express even under MORE_COMPUTE.
generator_self_modification_contract: Before hidden tasks are generated, derive exactly one reversible L3 CHANGE_GENERATOR_POLICY mutation from the cycle-6 fixed-family failure fossil. The mutation must replace the inherited GENERATOR implementation_ref with a hashed native representation-generator policy. The modified generator must survive SelfEvolvingResearchBody checkpoint/restore before hidden task generation.
compositional_language_contract: The descendant generator may search a generic postfix expression language built from variables x,y and reusable instruction tokens ADD,SUB,XOR,MIN,MAX with at most two binary operations. Hidden target expressions are sampled after candidate freeze and are not named families in source. Exact target expressions must be inferred from support examples; no hidden query outcome may enter synthesis.
hidden_task_generator: After generator-policy candidate freeze, evaluator-owned randomness creates 42 fresh tasks from distinct/evaluable two-operation expression programs outside the cycle-6 fixed primitive set. Each task supplies six support examples and one hidden query. Support is regenerated until exactly one expression in the frozen search language fits it.
full_control: Checkpoint/restore the generator-policy descendant before hidden task creation. For each hidden task, synthesize at most one task-specific L1 representation organ from support, checkpoint/restore it, then execute the hidden query.
remove_control: Cycle-6 NativeRepresentationGenesisEngine with its fixed family set receives the same support and unlimited local family retry/candidate budget. Any successful expression synthesis outside its fixed family set invalidates the generator-language-expansion claim.
more_compute_control: The parent may retry all fixed cycle-6 primitive families and up to 4096 ordinary morphology/meta candidates. It still must not produce the task-specific native expression representation.
wrong_control: Execute a different compositional expression program than the support-identified program; hidden accuracy must be below FULL.
shuffle_control: Use support examples from a different hidden expression task while preserving current query/artifact identity; hidden accuracy must be below FULL.
restart_control: Generator-policy fingerprint, synthesized representation-program fingerprint and hidden-query behavior must reproduce exactly after independent BODY checkpoint restore.
